How it works

Six steps, start to finish

One flow that runs from a customer tapping a product to an admin placing the bulk order.

01

Browse SHEIN products

Explore the catalogue in the app and find what you want. View product details, images, sizes, colours and prices.

02

Place your order

Select the products you like and submit the order straight to your preferred agent.

03

Your agent receives it

The agent gets the order in the Agent Panel, reviews the requested products and manages it from one dashboard.

04

Admin reviews everything

The Admin Panel gives a complete view of customer and agent orders, ready to be organised and consolidated.

05

Orders become one bulk order

Instead of processing purchases one by one, the admin combines multiple customer orders into a single batch.

06

Everything stays in one place

From submission to processing to bulk purchasing, the whole process is managed digitally on one platform.
